description: Render a declared view or a targeted pseudo-view of a model given by modelHash, paths or sources as diagram data (the RenderView RPC; the workspace group's render_view renders by name over the root): nodes flattened parents first, edges with their ports, table columns and rows, canvas, notes and notices. The result is the RenderViewResponse as protojson writes it; the text lists the nodes and edges.

compartments.description: how a tree rendering folds a node's owned members into compartment rows of its parent: positioned (the default), most or ports, as sysml -render-compartments takes them

depth.description: how many levels of nested elements to draw below each exposed element, overriding the view's own depth; 0 or absent draws every level

modelHash.description: the model_hash a parse answered; give this, or paths and/or sources to parse first

paths.description: model files to parse as one model, absolute or relative to the workspace root

ports.description: minimal (the default) or full: how many of a part's ports are drawn

show.description: optional notation elements to draw besides those the view's rendering shows, as sysml -render-show takes them: parameter-symbols, port-symbols, compartments, edge-labels, keywords, multiplicities, typings, qualifiers, or all

sources.description: documents given inline, parsed with paths as one model

language.description: sysml or kerml; empty is inferred from path's extension, sysml when it has none

path.description: name the document is reported by in diagnostics and indexed under; a .kerml extension makes it KerML unless language says otherwise

text.description: the document's source text; empty is an empty document

strictConformance.description: judge the documents as conforming SysML v2: notation no pinned production admits is an error rather than a warning

view.description: a qualified view name, or a #<kind>:<qualified name> pseudo-view targeting an element (#interconnection:Demo::Vehicle, #tree:Demo, #state:Demo::Lamp, #action:Demo::Descend, #sequence:..., #case:..., #requirement:..., #mixed:...)

name: render_model_view
